description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Dark Radiant Shield: 75%] to all allies, grants [Attach Dark], [Awoken Dark] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dark
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Dark Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Dark damage capped at 9999

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%
